summary: L3Harris Technologies filed an 8-K on August 16, 2026, announcing the appointment of Sam Mehta as President and CEO, effective immediately, succeeding Christopher Kubasik, who separated as CEO and Chairman. Mehta, previously president of the SMS and CSD segments (about 80% of revenue), received new compensation: $1.25 million base salary, 200% target bonus, $13.25 million LTI target, plus perquisites and severance eligibility. Kubasik's separation details and any succession rationale were not fully disclosed. Watch for further disclosure on leadership transition and strategic continuity.
